title: Use of AI Chatbots for Counselling and Mental Health Support by Teenagers and Young Adults
what_it_is: Use of AI Chatbots for Counselling and Mental Health Support by Teenagers and Young Adults

sections.label: GenAI chatbots and mental health
sections.summary: GenAI chatbots are not appropriate replacements for qualified mental health providers and may cause harm in crises.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health)
sentences.text: In general, it is not appropriate to use generative AI (GenAI) chatbots as a replacement for a qualified mental health care provider.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health)
sentences.text: AI chatbots are not designed to address mental health issues or provide treatment for mental health conditions and risk providing misinformation or inappropriate responses when dealing with serious mental health crises, and may cause harm instead.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Our approach is to encourage individuals seeking qualified mental health services to approach our First Stop for Mental Health services such as national mindline 1771, mindline.sg, Community Outreach Teams and CHAT.

sections.label: App stores age assurance
sections.summary: Designated app stores must implement age assurance measures by 31 March this year.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Designated app stores are also required to implement age assurance measures by 31 March this year.

sections.label: Data privacy and informed consent
sections.summary: Online resources such as mindline.sg work on the basis of anonymity.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: On her first question on how can we assess data privacy and whether informed consent is needed, I think in the first instance, many of these resources we put online, such as mindline.sg, works on the basis of anonymity.

sections.label: Wysa rule-based chatbot
sections.summary: Wysa supplements counselling as a 24/7 pocket therapist using a clinician-validated rule-based model, unlike GenAI chatbots.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: It aims to supplement our existing professional counselling and therapy services by serving as a 24/7 available pocket therapist that removes any barriers towards help seeking and signpost help seekers to local human-based resources.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: But just to reassure the Member, unlike GenAI chatbots, Wysa is designed to deliver such digital therapeutic exercises via a rule-based model.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: It is not something like the chatbot itself can be extremely creative and come up with a new suggestions.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: There is a rule-based model in it, so the conversation follows a structured decision tree, which is developed and continuously validated by clinicians.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: The Wysa chatbot has been clinically evaluated for its efficacy, safety and impact.
